sources.snippet: This repository hosts the GGUF build of MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 for llama.cpp. For the original weights, the full model card, and benchmarks, see the base repository. MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (1.3B) parses documents into text, tables, formulas, charts, and seals, and supports key information extraction, for Chinese and English documents and PDFs. sources.snippet: MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (1.3B) is the first OCR-specific model in the MiniCPM-V/o family. It focuses on text-centric document understanding, covering text, tables, formulas, charts, seals, and structured information extraction.
